capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: same hardware as MY2024 (the page read); model years compared 2024 to 2026, nothing shows a change. CarExpert: 102 kWh usable; InsideEVs "usable capacity of 102 kWh"; ArenaEV 101.7. Spectre and Black Badge share the pack; 2024-2026 compared: no change.

capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Estimated: same hardware as MY2024 (the page read); model years compared 2024 to 2026, nothing shows a change. CarExpert and InsideEVs about 120 kWh; ArenaEV 105.7 and Green Cars Compare 107: conflict.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: same hardware as MY2024 (the page read); model years compared 2024 to 2026, nothing shows a change. Popular Science: "102 kilowatt-hour, 400-volt battery pack" (derived from BMW Group); not read on a Rolls-Royce page.

dc_max_kw.notes: Estimated: same hardware as MY2024 (the page read); model years compared 2024 to 2026, nothing shows a change. CarExpert: up to 195 kW (Green Cars Compare 195). InsideEVs 205 kW, ArenaEV 200 kW, evspecs.org 220 kW.

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: same hardware as MY2024 (the page read); model years compared 2024 to 2026, nothing shows a change. Green Cars Compare: 22 kW AC (CarExpert and ArenaEV 22 kW; Rolls-Royce UK charging page says up to 22 kW per a search excerpt, not opened). evspecs.org says 11 kW. Not confirmed for US cars.

published_10_80_min.notes: Estimated: same hardware as MY2024 (the page read); model years compared 2024 to 2026, nothing shows a change. Popular Science: 10-80 % in about 34 min at a DC charger (CarExpert, InsideEVs 34 min).
